verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own documentation includes a walkthrough for installing and deploying Bitwarden on your own Linux server, which delivers the core of self-hosting the sync server. The evidence is only a single first-party docs mention, though. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that all secrets and sync traffic stay inside the perimeter (no cloud dependency), details on pointing clients and sync at the self-hosted instance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
